findings.reasoning: The function is public and allows any caller to push arbitrary values into the private bonusCodes array, effectively letting anyone modify contract state without restriction.
The function is public and lets any caller reduce the length of the bonusCodes array, potentially deleting entries added by others, which is an unrestricted state change.
The function is public and permits any address to overwrite values at any valid index of the bonusCodes array, giving unrestricted write access to contract storage.
